It refuses the direct, computed, destructured and globalThis forms and Date passed as a value, but not an alias of Math, performance, process or crypto through another name, a stored Intl formatter's format(), eval, Function or Reflect, nor code core imports from a dependency. It does not show that each surface passes the time it was given.

obligations.why: an event's time is the one its surface gave, so a replay reaches the same decisions

claims.source: docs/conventions/testing.md (fakes, not mocks; corrected by card R4); docs/architecture.md (lifecycle: nothing runs on a timer); packages/core/src/db/postgres.ts and postgres-worker.ts

the transport's Date.now calls are found at lines 34, 41, 54 and 211, 229, so each file is read to its end

obligations.heading: Record-keeping
obligations.quote: High-risk AI systems shall technically allow for the automatic recording of events (logs) over the lifetime of the system.

obligations.heading: Record-keeping
obligations.quote: In order to ensure a level of traceability of the functioning of a high-risk AI system that is appropriate to the intended purpose of the system, logging capabilities shall enable the recording of events relevant for:

obligations.heading: Record-keeping
obligations.quote: identifying situations that may result in the high-risk AI system presenting a risk within the meaning of Article 79(1) or in a substantial modification;

obligations.heading: Record-keeping
obligations.quote: monitoring the operation of high-risk AI systems referred to in Article 26(5).

obligations.heading: Transparency and provision of information to deployers
obligations.quote: where applicable, the technical capabilities and characteristics of the high-risk AI system to provide information that is relevant to explain its output;

obligations.heading: Human oversight
obligations.quote: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way, including with appropriate human-machine interface tools, that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which they are in use.

obligations.heading: Human oversight
obligations.quote: to correctly interpret the high-risk AI system’s output, taking into account, for example, the interpretation tools and methods available;

obligations.heading: Human oversight
obligations.quote: to decide, in any particular situation, not to use the high-risk AI system or to otherwise disregard, override or reverse the output of the high-risk AI system;

obligations.heading: Accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
obligations.quote: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way that they achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity, and that they perform consistently in those respects throughout their lifecycle.

obligations.heading: Accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
obligations.quote: High-risk AI systems shall be resilient against attempts by unauthorised third parties to alter their use, outputs or performance by exploiting system vulnerabilities.

obligations.heading: Automatically generated logs
obligations.quote: the logs shall be kept for a period appropriate to the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system, of at least six months, unless provided otherwise in the applicable Union or national law, in particular in Union law on the protection of personal data.

obligations.heading: Obligations of deployers of high-risk AI systems
obligations.quote: Deployers shall monitor the operation of the high-risk AI system on the basis of the instructions for use

obligations.heading: Obligations of deployers of high-risk AI systems
obligations.quote: Deployers of high-risk AI systems shall keep the logs automatically generated by that high-risk AI system to the extent such logs are under their control, for a period appropriate to the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system, of at least six months

obligations.heading: Principles relating to processing of personal data
obligations.quote: adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary in relation to the purposes for which they are processed (‘data minimisation’);

obligations.heading: Principles relating to processing of personal data
obligations.quote: accurate and, where necessary, kept up to date; every reasonable step must be taken to ensure that personal data that are inaccurate, having regard to the purposes for which they are processed, are erased or rectified without delay (‘accuracy’);

obligations.heading: Principles relating to processing of personal data
obligations.quote: kept in a form which permits identification of data subjects for no longer than is necessary for the purposes for which the personal data are processed;

obligations.heading: Principles relating to processing of personal data
obligations.quote: processed in a manner that ensures appropriate security of the personal data, including protection against unauthorised or unlawful processing and against accidental loss, destruction or damage, using appropriate technical or organisational measures (‘integrity and confidentiality’).

obligations.heading: Principles relating to processing of personal data
obligations.quote: The controller shall be responsible for, and be able to demonstrate compliance with, paragraph 1 (‘accountability’).

obligations.heading: Conditions for consent
obligations.quote: Where processing is based on consent, the controller shall be able to demonstrate that the data subject has consented to processing of his or her personal data.

obligations.heading: Conditions for consent
obligations.quote: The data subject shall have the right to withdraw his or her consent at any time.

obligations.heading: Right to erasure (‘right to be forgotten’)
obligations.quote: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller the erasure of personal data concerning him or her without undue delay and the controller shall have the obligation to erase personal data without undue delay where one of the following grounds applies:

obligations.heading: Responsibility of the controller
obligations.quote: the controller shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure and to be able to demonstrate that processing is performed in accordance with this Regulation.

obligations.heading: Data protection by design and by default
obligations.quote: both at the time of the determination of the means for processing and at the time of the processing itself, implement appropriate technical and organisational measures

obligations.heading: Data protection by design and by default
obligations.quote: That obligation applies to the amount of personal data collected, the extent of their processing, the period of their storage and their accessibility. In particular, such measures shall ensure that by default personal data are not made accessible without the individual's intervention to an indefinite number of natural persons.

obligations.heading: Records of processing activities
obligations.quote: where possible, the envisaged time limits for erasure of the different categories of data;

obligations.heading: Security of processing
obligations.quote: the ability to ensure the ongoing confidentiality, integrity, availability and resilience of processing systems and services;

obligations.heading: Security of processing
obligations.quote: a process for regularly testing, assessing and evaluating the effectiveness of technical and organisational measures for ensuring the security of the processing.

ai-act.amended_by: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (Digital Omnibus on AI), OJ L, 2026/1744, 24.7.2026, http://publications.europa.eu/resource/celex/32026R1744, read 2026-11-21. Its amending provisions change the text of none of Articles 12, 13, 14, 15, 19 and 26 cited here. Its point (18) adds Article 42(3), under which high-risk AI systems within the scope of Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 for which the conditions of its Article 12(1) hold are deemed to comply with the cybersecurity requirements set out in Article 15; that bears on rows AIA-15-1 and AIA-15-5. Its new Article 113, third paragraph, point (c) makes Chapter III, Sections 1 to 3, with the exception of Article 6(5), apply from 2 December 2027 for high-risk systems under Article 6(2) and Annex III and from 2 August 2028 under Article 6(1) and Annex I.
ai-act.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 June 2024 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)

gdpr.amended_by: The text as published in the Official Journal; corrigenda were not read. No article number cited here is changed by a corrigendum the Publications Office lists for this act, which was not checked either.
gdpr.title: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data (General Data Protection Regulation)

statement: Engram supplies evidence about how a memory control plane behaves: each row names a claim, the test in this repository that proves it, and an article of the EU AI Act or the GDPR the evidence bears on. A row never says that Engram, or a deployment using it, meets an obligation. Whether a deployment is compliant depends on its purpose, its operator and facts the plane cannot see.
